@@note: Every place text appears in the game, one row each (research/text-system.md). The build turns this table into the game's text CSS, so changing how text looks or sits means changing its row. face: pixel (Pixelify Sans) or arcade (Press Start 2P). size in px, with mid (phones up to 700 px tall), short (up to 640 px tall) and narrow (up to 360 px wide) where they differ. lh: line height. track: letter spacing in px. wrap: line (never wraps), balance (even lines) or pretty (no lone last word). lines: the most lines it may take (the text check holds it to that). trim: centered on its letters, not on the font's invisible padding (CSS text-box). nudge: [x, y] in px. fit: how far a too-wide word may tighten its letter spacing, in device pixels, so the step is the same on 2× and 3× phones. Weight 600 is the game's (body) weight unless the row says otherwise. fallback: the size for a browser without container units (iOS 15), written before size.
